Categories.value: Transfăgărășan|Taken with Canon EOS 40D|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR|Files from Horia Varlan Flickr stream

ImageDescription.value: Taken a few meters down from Balea Lake, on the northern part of the road. It shows the curvy lanes going down through the glacier's valley. Luckily the clouds were on their way to Sibiu so the view was clear. A section from what Top Gear called the greatest road in the world.
